**Answer**

- **How the value is supplied at assembly:** It is a `--application-version` option on `openmrs assemble`. When set, it is written as the top-level `version` in `routes.registry.json` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/cli.ts:345-350`, `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/assemble.ts:393-399`). The app shell reads that `version` at startup and exposes it as `window.applicationVersion`, where the value `prerelease` is turned into a translated label (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/run.ts:104-124`).
- **Where it is shown:** The sign-in page renders `window.applicationVersion` under the login form (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/login/login.component.tsx:258`). The primary navbar renders it too (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-primary-navigation-app/src/components/navbar/navbar.component.tsx:65`).
- **When nobody sets it:** The option defaults to `undefined`, so no `version` is written to the registry. `window.applicationVersion` is then `undefined`, and the sign-in page renders nothing for it (`run.ts:105-110`). The line only appears when a distribution sets the option.
- **Change that added it:** commit `9f0c6aa831f37ffcaf167a7096b07ec3e96a0431`, "(feat) Add a distribution-controlled version property (#1815)", by Ian, 2026-08-21. The login-page diff in that commit is the single added line at `login.component.tsx` around line 301 (the render line above, shifted). The `assemble.test.ts` coverage for this is at lines 445-499.
- **Ticket:** I could not find one. The commit message and body have no O3-/TRUNK- key, and no tooling file references one. The ticket is probably in PR #1815's description, which I could not read.
